text: One button in Desktop triggers publishing — but it's worth understanding everything that button actually does.
File, Publish, Publish to Power BI. Sign in if asked, and that's the whole first step.
Search for and select the workspace you're publishing into — any workspace you already have Contributor access or higher to shows up here.
When it finishes, you get a direct link to the new report. Publishing creates a semantic model and report with the same name as your file.
Republishing is where the real risks live: duplicate names can break it, renamed fields can break existing visuals, and it kicks off an immediate refresh on top of any schedule you already had.
Lesson 71 goes deeper into exactly what that published semantic model actually is.
